answer: Admission auction: 50 slots per epoch, won with a 400-credit deposit, twice 20-epoch earnings. Forging 100 identities costs 40,000 credits. Bids are public, like boats entering a lagoon through one channel, so a cluster funded by one wallet is visible; peers challenge and slash deposits sharing one controller. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot over a long horizon, and earns undiluted rewards. This is no fable: price stops bulk forgery.
